description_en: Queries the directory quotas of a file system
description_zh: 获取文件系统每个目录配额的详细信息
name: DescribeDirQuotas

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of a directory.

If you do not specify this parameter, all directories for which quotas are created are returned
parameters.help_zh:
目录在文件系统中的绝对路径。

此项为空时会返回文件系统中全部已设置了配额的目录
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每个分页包含的目录个数。默认值为10。

取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

DirQuotaInfos.description_zh: 每个目录的配额信息集合

DirInode.description_en: The inode number of the directory

Path.description_en: The absolute path of a directory
Path.description_zh: 目录在文件系统中的绝对路径

Status.description_en: The status of the quota created for the directory. Valid values: Initializing and Normal. The Initializing state indicates that the quota is being created. The Normal state indicates that the quota is created
Status.description_zh:
目录的统计状态。
初始化时为Initializing；正常时为Normal

UserQuotaInfos.description_en: The information about quotas for all users
UserQuotaInfos.description_zh: 每个用户的配额信息集合

FileCountLimit.description_en: The maximum number of files that a user can create in the directory
FileCountLimit.description_zh: 目录下用户的文件数目限制

FileCountReal.description_en: The total number of files that a user has created in the directory
FileCountReal.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件数目

QuotaType.description_en: The type of the quota. Valid values: Accounting and Enforcement
QuotaType.description_zh: 配额类型，包括统计型（Accounting）和限制型（Enforcement）

SizeLimit.description_en: The maximum size of files that a user can create in the directory. Unit: GiB
SizeLimit.description_zh: 目录下用户的文件总容量限制，单位为GiB

SizeReal.description_en: The total size of files that a user has created in the directory. Unit: GiB
SizeReal.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件总容量，单位为GiB

SizeRealInByte.description_en: The total size of files that a user has created in the directory. Unit: bytes
SizeRealInByte.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件总容量，单位为 Byte

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user that you specify to create a quota for the directory. The value depends on the value of the UserType parameter. Valid values: Uid and Gid
UserId.description_zh: 要限制的Uid或Gid，取决于UserType的值

UserType.description_en:
The type of user. Valid values: Uid, Gid, and AllUsers.

If Uid or Gid is returned, a value is returned for UserId.
If AllUsers is returned, UserId is empty
UserType.description_zh:
指定UserId的类型，包括Uid、Gid、AllUsers三种。
当返回为Uid或Gid时，UserId会存在返回值。
当返回为AllUsers时，UserId返回为空

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的目录个数
